fusions.name: Hopping Cinder
fusions.desc: Flicks a cinder that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then hops to 3 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Failing Host
fusions.desc: A biting strike that deals 20 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Sudden Bound
fusions.desc: You leap 3 tiles and your dodge chance rises by 25% for 10 seconds. A cloud of burning sparks fights beside you for 6 seconds, striking for 3 every 1 second.

fusions.name: New Host
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions runs out on an enemy, a spark leaps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 7 damage. Once every 3 seconds.
